name: Dr. Aisha Nkosi
awards: South African Science and Technology Award
personal_statement: My prior mission as payload specialist taught me that the difference between a good crew and a great crew is not technical — it is cognitive. I study how human decision-making degrades under isolation, fatigue, and high stakes, and I know how to design interventions that preserve it. I am applying for a mission role because I want to apply that science from inside the system, not from a control room 400 kilometres below it.
psychological_profile: Unique profile: low flight hours but genuine prior mission experience as payload specialist. Cognitive performance research background adds rare crew-level value. Psychological assessment scores in the 91st percentile. Flight hours remain the primary gap for a mission-critical seat; strong candidate for science crew roles.
